title: endpoint-qualified dense fixed-to-C2 route-bifurcation replay
status: four frozen source trajectories; exact replay gate and diagnostic thresholds frozen before replay
hypothesis: The reproducible L3 route is selected during C2: seeds2203, 2551, and 2909 will develop a registered weak L3-selective precursor between the fixed endpoint and C2, while the exceptional seed1879 trajectory will not develop that precursor.

exact_replay.post-fixed_seed_reset: set_seed(model_seed + 20000) exactly as in the original training path
exact_replay.saved_milestones: original fixed endpoint as step0, then replay step1 and every100 steps through each source's exact stop

per_seed_endpoint_qualification_gate.CUDA_RNG: byte-exact match for every saved device state
per_seed_endpoint_qualification_gate.validation_history: exact match for every C2 validation record
per_seed_endpoint_qualification_gate.failure_action: close only that seed's causal panel and exclude its intermediate milestones from mechanistic interpretation

registered_profiles.formed_behavior: intact query >=0.90 and minimum local across conditions >=0.90
registered_profiles.whole_memory_causal: formed behavior and reset-all, zero-all, and batch-roll-all query <=0.20
registered_profiles.strict_L3_core: whole-Memory causal; zero-L3 and roll-L3 <=0.20; keep-L3 >=0.90; zero-L1 and zero-L2 >=0.80; keep-L1 and keep-L2 <=0.20
registered_profiles.weak_L3_selective_precursor: not strict L3 core; intact >=0.20; minimum local >=0.90; all whole-Memory controls <=0.20; zero-L3 and roll-L3 <=0.20; keep-L3 >=0.20; keep-L1 and keep-L2 <=0.20; zero-L1 and zero-L2 each >= max(0.20, intact-0.05); keep-L3 minus max(keep-L1,keep-L2) >=0.10

per_seed_registered_outcomes.L3_precursor_formed_during_C2: step0 is not precursor, a later replay milestone is precursor, and the C2 endpoint remains precursor or strict L3 core
per_seed_registered_outcomes.L3_precursor_preexisting_at_fixed: step0 already passes the weak precursor rule
per_seed_registered_outcomes.L3_precursor_regressed_before_C2: a precursor occurs but neither precursor nor strict L3 core is present at the C2 endpoint
per_seed_registered_outcomes.L3_precursor_absent_through_C2: no saved milestone passes the weak precursor or strict L3-core rule
per_seed_registered_outcomes.replay_endpoint_mismatch_causal_panel_cl: the seed fails one or more endpoint exactness gates

cohort_registered_classification.default_L3_precursor_divergence_confirme: all exact gates pass; all three Level7.5 L3 seeds form a weak L3 precursor during C2; seed1879 remains precursor-negative through C2
cohort_registered_classification.L3_precursor_not_route_specific: all exact gates pass and seed1879 also forms the registered L3 precursor
cohort_registered_classification.L3_precursor_not_universal: all exact gates pass but one or more Level7.5 L3 seeds never form the registered precursor
cohort_registered_classification.exact_replay_incomplete_causal_interpret: one or more exact replay gates fail
cohort_registered_classification.route_bifurcation_unresolved: all gates pass but the fixed classifications do not satisfy another registered cohort outcome

secondary_outputs: first weak L3 precursor and first strict L3-core step per seed
full L1/L2/L3 necessity, roll-sensitivity, single and pair sufficiency trajectory
in-range C2 validation versus fresh 16-chunk behavior
parameter displacement from the fixed-stage endpoint
scope: This compares four deterministic training trajectories on the current software/hardware stack. Exact replay is required before interpreting a seed. The result localizes route selection on one synthetic task and does not estimate population frequencies.
stop_rule: Report the fixed exactness and cohort classifications; do not insert post-hoc milestones, relax a precursor threshold, extend a failed replay, or replace a source.
